data.title: 泽塔 · 只念给一人的报告
data.description: 庭园谒见厅里，泽塔单膝跪地，向暗影汇报这个月的谍报。她的声音依旧平淡，唯独抬头望向暗影时，紫眸里多了一点光。
data.location: shadow garden audience chamber with a dark throne and kneeling figure
data.action: kneeling on one knee reporting, head slightly raised toward the throne, composed expression
data.lighting: 谒见厅高窗漏下的冷峻月光
data.promptProse: Zeta kneels and delivers her report to Shadow alone — the only voice in the world she answers fully.
data.animaCaption: Her reports have one listener. They always have.
